posts.en:
dsh-history is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and click-to-jump that auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3da71ba574828a432c54.html
